kind: MCPServer
metadata:
  name: qdrant-mcp
  namespace: kagent
spec:
  transportType: stdio
  stdioTransport: {}
  deployment:
    # Ours; scaffolded with `kmcp init go`, source in mcp/qdrant-mcp. Replaces
    # mcp-server-qdrant, which could only embed in-process with fastembed and
    # was OOMKilled doing it.
    image: ghcr.io/den-vasyliev/abox/qdrant-mcp:0.4.0
    cmd: /app/server
    env:
      # Any OpenAI-compatible /v1/embeddings route. The standalone llama.cpp
      # Deployment, serving nomic-embed-text-v1.5 as f16 at 8 slots x 2048 ctx.
      # This is the starting point of the migration exercise; the other route is
      # llm-d's decode Service:
      #
      #   http://llm-d-embedding.llm-d:8000
      #
      # hit directly rather than through the EPP, whose scorers are built for
      # generation traffic, not a pooling runner's single-shot embed. Direct
      # means no model-based routing, so EMBEDDINGS_MODEL stays unset there too:
      # llama.cpp ignores it and serves the one GGUF it was given. A managed
      # endpoint would need EMBEDDINGS_MODEL and EMBEDDINGS_API_KEY -- see
      # mcp/qdrant-mcp/README.md, "Switching the embeddings backend".
      #
      # chat returns 501 against either: both are started with --embeddings and
      # have no generation head.
      EMBEDDINGS_BASE_URL: http://llama-cpp-embeddings.llama-cpp:8090
      # vector_store / vector_find embed through the same endpoint, so the
      # agent's memory lands in the vector space the gateway serves. The
      # collection is named for that space. llm-d serves the same model at Q8_0
      # rather than f16 -- same 768 dims, different kernels -- so the two routes
      # are two spaces and the vectors do not transfer. Repointing
      # EMBEDDINGS_BASE_URL is therefore a re-embed, not a copy.
      QDRANT_URL: http://qdrant.qdrant:6333
      QDRANT_COLLECTION: abox-nomic
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: 25m
        memory: 32Mi
      limits:
        cpu: 500m
        memory: 256Mi

kind: HelmRelease
metadata:
  name: llm-d-pool
  namespace: llm-d
spec:
  interval: 1h

    # nothing to pick. Not a hard requirement, but it keeps first-apply ordering
    # readable.

    kind: OCIRepository
    name: inferencepool
    namespace: flux-system

    createNamespace: true

      # HealthCheckPolicy/GCPBackendPolicy objects whose CRDs only exist on GKE.
      # "none" is the right value for KinD.
      name: none

      # 4-core Codespace can satisfy -- the pod sits Pending with
      # "Insufficient cpu". This key is nested under inferenceExtension; a
      # top-level `resources` is silently ignored.

          memory: 128Mi
        limits:

          memory: 512Mi

          # above is off.
          enabled: false
